attempt.notes: Full opus pipeline. Tess 2 dispatches; the step-2.8 quality gate passed first time. DEVON broke the suite (437 passed, 0 failed) with three separate weaknesses, one of them CRITICAL and the most valuable find of the cycle: a fallback discard reason that quotes a 40-character PREFIX of the model's next line passes both guards, because the test forbade only the WHOLE stripped later line and the sentinel test forbade only the exact 44-char sentinel. His second weakness: the three blank-discard fixtures collapse to two distinct cases after stripping, so a literal membership set passes while 'DISCARD:   \n...' still yields an empty reason. His third: no test ran --distil with a triage that SUCCEEDS and keeps nobody, so gating the stage on len(survivors) instead of on the triage error passed all 437 - the exact wrong fix, since it collapses 'stage did not run' with 'stage ran and found nothing'. Tess closed all three: the blank-case reason is now pinned by identity to the bare-token reason (admitting no truncated tail at all), the parametrisation is generated from 4 paddings x 3 tails = 12 cases, and the missing keeps-nobody companion test uses FakeClaudeCli's transient_texts parameter, which existed in the fixture and had never been used. TEST DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR: Ivan reported 4 of the 14 unsatisfiable, and he was right. The 'prose-further-down' tails open with a blank line, so the loop reached 'assert later_line.strip() not in result.reason' with an empty string, and '' is in every Python string, making the assertion always false. Verified directly before acting. Fixed with a one-line blank-line skip rather than a Tess dispatch, since the defect was proven and had exactly one correct form; then PROVED the correction did not neuter the test by stashing Ivan's implementation and re-running - all 14 still red - before restoring. Removing a redundant-but-independent guard on a data-leak invariant is the kind of simplification the review checklist explicitly warns against. Recorded here so the PRD-level lenses can overrule.
